test_title: PYST 11: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.

Jack loves the Christmas break.

options.text: The Christmas break is loved by Jack.
The Christmas break was loved by Jack.
The Christmas break would loved by Jack.
The Christmas break is being loved by Jack.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb form changes to include a form of "**to be**" and the past participle of the main verb.
 
• In the given sentence, "**Jack**" is the subject, "**loves**" is the verb, and "**the Christmas break**" is the object.
 
• To change it to the passive voice, "**the Christmas break**" becomes the subject, and "**Jack**" becomes the agent introduced by "**by**."
 
• The verb "**loves**" in the present tense changes to "**is loved**" in the passive voice.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1: The Christmas break is loved by Jack.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "The Christmas break was loved by Jack."** – This uses the past tense "was," but the original sentence is in the present tense.
 
• **Option 3: "The Christmas break would loved by Jack."** – This is grammatically incorrect because "would loved" is not a correct verb form.
 
• **Option 4: "The Christmas break is being loved by Jack."** – The present continuous tense "is being loved" is not required here since the original sentence is in the simple present tense.
